title: RelativeTensorPullbackKFlatModel
statement: Let f:X -> S be a scheme morphism with the fixed derived categories and tensor. For K-flat complexes A over O_X and L over O_S and every integer i, the underlying abelian sheaf of H^i(Q(A) tensor Lf*(Q(L))) is isomorphic to that of H^i(Tot(A restricted to f-inverse O_S tensor termwise inverse-image L)). The restriction of A need not be K-flat.

source.place: Cohomology Lemma 20.27.4, Tag 08DE; Tag 08EV, second displayed equality

proof.text: Extract the additive tensor-pullback functor and its K-flat counit from the recorded derived pullback. Transport through the homotopy quotient factorization to identify Lf*(Q(L)) with Q of its termwise pullback.
Evaluate the K-flat derived tensor natural comparison on constant singleton families A and the pulled-back L. Apply derived homology and its localization factorization.
Apply the ordinary complex balanced tensor comparison. Exact forgetful functors commute with homology; compose their two homology comparisons with homology of the abelian-sheaf chain isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Tag 08DE, proof: balanced tensor identity and definitions
